title: Privacy Policy
intro: Boxium (hereinafter referred to as "the Platform" or "we") values the protection of your privacy. This Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as "this Policy") explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect the personal data you provide when using the Platform's services. Please read this Policy carefully to understand our approach to handling personal data.

section1.title: 1. Collection of Personal Data
section1.p1: When you use the Platform's services, we may collect the following types of personal data:

subsection1.title: 1.1 Data You Actively Provide
subsection1.p1: When you register an account, use specific features, or contact us, you may actively provide the following data:
items: Personal preference settings (such as favorite cards, price alert settings, etc.)
Other information you enter when using the Platform's features

subsection2.title: 1.2 Automatically Collected Data
subsection2.p1: When you visit or use the Platform, we automatically collect certain technical information, including:
items: Pages viewed and feature usage records
Information collected by cookies and similar technologies

section2.title: 2. Purpose of Using Personal Data
section2.p1: We collect your personal data primarily for the following purposes:

purposes.title: Providing Services:
purposes.desc: To provide you with core services such as card price inquiries, price trend analysis, and favorites management

purposes.title: Improving Services:
purposes.desc: To analyze user behavior and preferences, and optimize platform features and user experience

purposes.title: Personalized Experience:
purposes.desc: To provide customized content and recommendations based on your preferences

purposes.title: Notifications and Communication:
purposes.desc: To send you service updates, price alerts, or other important notifications

purposes.title: Security Maintenance:
purposes.desc: To detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, or other illegal activities

purposes.title: Legal Compliance:
purposes.desc: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, or court orders

section3.title: 3. Disclosure and Sharing of Personal Data
section3.p1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may disclose or share your personal data in the following circumstances:

scenarios.title: Service Providers:
scenarios.desc: We may share your data with third-party service providers who assist us in providing services (such as cloud storage services, data analysis tools, etc.). These service providers may only use your data within the scope of providing services and must comply with confidentiality obligations

scenarios.title: Legal Requirements:
scenarios.desc: When required by law, regulations, court orders, or government agencies, we may need to disclose your data

scenarios.title: Protection of Rights:
scenarios.desc: To protect the rights, property, or safety of the Platform, users, or the public, we may need to disclose your data

scenarios.title: Business Transfers:
scenarios.desc: If the Platform undergoes a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your personal data may be transferred as part of the business assets

section4.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
section4.p1: The Platform uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to improve your user experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that record your preference settings, login status, and usage behavior.
section4.p2: The types of cookies we use include:

types.title: Essential Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies are necessary for the basic functionality of the Platform, such as maintaining your login status

types.title: Functional Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies are used to remember your preference settings and provide a more personalized experience

types.title: Analytical Cookies:
types.desc: These cookies help us understand how users use the Platform so we can improve our services

section4.p3: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. However, please note that disabling cookies may affect some features of the Platform.

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.p1: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction. These measures include but are not limited to:
measures: Using encryption technology to protect data transmission
Restricting employee and service provider access to personal data
Regularly reviewing and updating security measures
section5.p2: However, please note that no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention Period
section6.p1: We only retain your personal data for the period necessary to achieve the purpose of collection. When your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it. The specific retention period depends on the data type and purpose of use, for example:
periods: Account data: Retained during the validity period of your account and for a reasonable period after account deletion
Usage records: Typically retained for 12 to 24 months
Data required by law: Retained according to the period stipulated by law

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.p1: Under applicable personal data protection laws, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

rights.title: Right to Access:
rights.desc: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you

rights.title: Right to Rectification:
rights.desc: If your personal data is inaccurate or incomplete, you have the right to request correction

rights.title: Right to Erasure:
rights.desc: In certain circumstances, you have the right to request deletion of your personal data

rights.title: Right to Restriction of Processing:
rights.desc: In certain circumstances, you have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data

rights.title: Right to Data Portability:
rights.desc: You have the right to request to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format

rights.title: Right to Object:
rights.desc: You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests

section7.p2: If you wish to exercise any of the above rights, please contact us through the following contact methods. We will respond to your request within a reasonable period.

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.p1: The Platform's services are intended for the general public, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13 years of age. If you are a parent or guardian and discover that your child has provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us, and we will delete the relevant data as soon as possible.

section9.title: 9. Cross-Border Data Transfer
section9.p1: Your personal data may be transferred to locations outside your country or region for processing or storage. We will ensure that these data transfers comply with applicable personal data protection laws and take appropriate protective measures.

section10.title: 10. Policy Modifications
section10.p1: We may modify this Privacy Policy from time to time. The modified policy will be published on this page with the last update date noted. If the modifications are significant, we will notify you via email or platform notifications. We recommend that you regularly review this page to stay informed of the latest Privacy Policy.

section11.title: 11. Contact Us
